questions.question:
The sum of all the elements in the range of
f(x)=Sgn(\sin x)+Sgn(\cos x)+Sgn(\tan x)+Sgn(\cot x),
x \neq \frac{n\pi}{2}, n \in \mathbf{Z},
where
Sgn(t) = \begin{cases} 1, & \text{if } t > 0 \\ -1 & \text{if } t < 0 \end{cases} \text{ is}
questions.explanation:
### Step 1: Analyze the function in different quadrants

x \in (0, \pi/2) \implies y = 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 4
x \in (\pi/2, \pi) \implies y = 1 - 1 - 1 - 1 = -2
x \in (\pi, 3\pi/2) \implies y = -1 - 1 + 1 + 1 = 0
x \in (3\pi/2, 2\pi) \implies y = -1 + 1 - 1 - 1 = -2
\(\therefore\) Range of \(y\) is \(\{-2, 0, 4\}\)
Required sum \(= -2 + 0 + 4 = 2\)
